public_api.name: evidence.producer_runtime.managed_group_identity
public_api.input: Optional positive integer PID; default current caller. Explicit target must currently share caller PGID and SID. Uses SDD_PRODUCER_LEDGER and SDD_PRODUCER_ATTEMPT from existing active native environment.

output.owner: exact process_identity of requested live target PID
output.anchor: exact process_identity of the still-live existing registered gate
output.group_id: kernel PGID shared by caller,target,anchor; equals anchor.pid
output.session_id: kernel SID shared by caller,target,anchor; equals anchor.pid

public_api.errors: EvidenceError for non-POSIX, missing environment/sidecars, unsafe ledger path, malformed/missing/inactive native bindings, nonpending reservation, unbound run/output, dead/unknown coordinator or guardian, foreign target group/session, absent/ambiguous/dead/reused anchor, or changes during inspection.
public_api.readiness_is_not_authority: Result is a current group-membership observation only. It does not register or adopt processes, authenticate a new actor, establish containment, settle accounting, or prove membership after return.

mechanism: Use SQLite URI mode=ro and an authorizer permitting only SELECT/READ/transaction operations; never instantiate Accounting, migrate schema, enter accounting transactions or call mutation APIs.
Require the original absolute regular ledger and existing regular nonlinked WAL/SHM sidecars before opening. Refuse missing sidecars rather than create them. No immutable=1 or reconstructed snapshot.
Reuse producer_runtime.read against a small read-only connection/policy view, preserving the existing native ownership/binding validation.

Require running original attempt, pending original reservation, matching project/version/unit/output bindings and unchanged output directory identity; exact coordinator and guardian identities must be alive.
Read exact target identity and kernel group/session; require target membership in caller current group/session and one unique recorded anchor.

Verify exact target/anchor identities alive and anchor kernel PGID/SID both equal anchor PID. Release initial read snapshot, reread current native bindings, then repeat kernel identity/group checks before returning.
No registration, resource cleanup, signal, run completion, reservation release, catalog interaction, provider access or browser-specific code.

read_only_contract.root_explicit_decision: Ordinary SQLite read locks/read-mark updates in EXISTING SHM are acceptable. No SQL/schema/accounting/session mutations; DB and WAL bytes/tables unchanged; no new sidecars.
read_only_contract.observed: Real native fixtures verify zero connection.total_changes, trace only SELECT/BEGIN/ROLLBACK, unchanged DB/WAL SHA256 before/after helper call, no Accounting constructor and no os.kill/os.killpg calls. SHM hashes can change after a newer committed native snapshot because SQLite updates its existing read marks.
read_only_contract.not_claimed: No promise that all kernel locking/shared-memory bookkeeping bytes remain immutable, and no claim of race-free permanent group membership.
